<?php

$numbers = [52, 17, 38, 9, 61, 38, 24, 45];
$total = 0;
for ($i = 1; $i <= 7; $i++) {
    $value = $numbers[$i];
    $j = $i - 1;
    $shifts = 0;
    while ($j >= 0 && $numbers[$j] > $value) {
        $numbers[$j + 1] = $numbers[$j];
        $shifts++;
        $j--;
    }
    $numbers[$j + 1] = $value;
    $total += $shifts;
    printf("i=%d shifts=%d: %s\n", $i, $shifts, implode(' ', $numbers));
}
printf("total shifts: %d\n", $total);
